title: AShQ-Slicer-Nano
summary: A Jupyter notebook project that merges a 3D-slicer-style data interpretation pipeline with a neural 'LTM' engine and an added 'DreamLayer' inference stage for augmenting large tabular datasets. The DreamLayer class builds a SingleTableMetadata object and trains an sdv.single_table CTGANSynthesizer (epochs=500) to learn and reproduce patterns from the real dataframe, so SDV is run directly as the synthetic-data generator behind the dream inference feature.
needs: Notebook shows instantiation and metadata detection but no visible .fit()/.sample() call in the given excerpt, so full training/sampling usage is unverified.
